bounds: The zh-CN images are their OWN runs, not renamed copies: the WEB twin renders in the app's Chinese locale (browser context locale zh-CN, body text verified Chinese), and the TUI twin is a separate PTY capture. MEASURED: the TUI DAG page's chrome is English in BOTH locales (DSH_TUI_LANG=zh-CN left the pane byte-identical), which matches the established zh-CN set policy that 'the TUI scene bodies stay English by design'; the zh-CN TUI file is therefore the same scene from its own run, not a Chinese-chrome image.

The zh-CN TUI twin was WITHDRAWN after measurement: DSH_TUI_LANG=en / zh / zh-CN all produce a byte-identical DAG pane (the page's chrome is English in every locale, matching the established 'TUI scene bodies stay English by design' policy), so a zh-CN copy would be a byte-identical duplicate. The zh README + zh docs row cite the SHARED English-body TUI capture and say so in the caption; the three panes are kept here as the measurement.
The TUI capture requires the page's FULLSCREEN control: at the narrow sidebar width the group is collapsed by D3's declared bound, not half-drawn.
The web crop keeps the panel header + roster + the whole task graph; the empty space below the graph is dropped, not painted over.
The frame is CLOSED: the bottom border carries a crossing glyph (U+256B) where the outgoing edge leaves the box, and all four interior cards sit inside it.
